identity: Ossuary Reach shelves and labels the Throng's bones; the Gravewood is waking around the archive and a skeleton calling itself the Marrow Archivist is re-filing the dead under its own name.

quests.title: Teeth Beside the Archive
quests.text: Briarpack Blightfang Wolves prowl the {name:bonewood} {dir_of:r20_anchor_020:bonewood} by day and carry off whatever bones they can reach. Kill eight. Some of what they carry has labels on it already, and the labels are not mine.
quests.lesson: A daytime pack hunt in the bone forest.

quests.title: Rubbings from Boneledger Post
quests.text: Mereth Rubbinghand at Boneledger Post takes rubbings of every barrow stone in the Reach. Go and help; if the stones and my shelves disagree, I want to know which one is lying.
quests.lesson: Travel to the zone's second hub.

quests.title: Optional: The Trees That Refuse Rest
quests.text: At night the Lichen Gravewood Treants of the {name:bonewood} pull up their roots and walk through the burial rows. Fell eight. The Grave-Web Bonelurker Spiders between them are not my concern, but they will be yours.
quests.lesson: The same area's night roster: treants with a spider minor role.

quests.title: Archers on the Barrow Ridge
quests.text: Barrow Skeleton Archers stand guard on the {name:barrow_ridge} {dir_of:r20_anchor_038:barrow_ridge} at night and shoot at anyone with paper. Destroy eight so I can take my rubbings in peace. Someone has cut new names over the old ones on those stones; the archers only guard the work, they did not do it.
quests.lesson: A night hunt against ranged undead.

quests.title: Optional: Bones With Writing on Them
quests.text: The archers on the {name:barrow_ridge} carry Etched Bone. Bring me three; somebody has carved new names over the old ones, and I need to see whose hand it is.
quests.lesson: A drop request that shares the archer outing.

quests.title: The Hand Belongs to the Dig
quests.text: The new names on the barrow stones were cut with a miner's chisel. Go to Memoryvein Dig and ask Neris Fossilhand whose; Neris knows every tool in the Reach by its scratch.
quests.lesson: Travel to the zone's third hub.

quests.title: Optional: Bears in the Webwood
quests.text: Bonewood Plaguehide Bears den in the {name:webwood} {zone_area:webwood} by day and dig up the old shafts for the marrow. Kill eight. What they leave, the Marrow Archivist collects; I have watched it from the spoil heaps.
quests.lesson: Heavy daytime animals beside the climax's story.

quests.title: Optional: Steel for the Shoring
quests.text: Smelt six Steel Bars and bring them to the dig. The old shafts are full of names, and I would like to keep them up rather than under.
quests.lesson: Tier-three metal from the Reach's own rock.

quests.title: Refiling the Archivist
quests.text: The {name:marrow_archivist} stands in the {name:deepwood} {dir_from_giver:marrow_archivist} and re-labels every bone it finds under its own name. Destroy four of the Grave-Web Bonelurker Spiders that spin round it at night and end the Archivist; the Reach files its own dead.
quests.lesson: The heartland's climax: a named normal leader at the top of the zone.

quests.title: Repeatable: Wolves in the Ashfields
quests.text: Briarpack Blightfang Wolves hunt the {name:ashfields} {zone_area:ashfields} after dark. Kill six and come back; I post this again twenty minutes after you hand it in.
